items.stem: Which of the following is equivalent to the ratio $4:6$?
items.explanation: Dividing both terms by their GCD 2 gives $2:3$, which is the only equivalent ratio among the choices; the other options change the relationship.

items.stem: A recipe calls for 3 cups of flour to 5 cups of sugar. To keep the same proportion, how many cups of sugar are needed if you use 9 cups of flour?
items.explanation: The ratio $3:5$ simplifies to $9:15$ when the flour is tripled, so 15 cups of sugar are required; other answers misapply the ratio.

items.stem: On a map, 1 cm represents 40 km. If a road on the map measures 2.5 cm, what is the actual length of the road?
items.explanation: Multiplying the map distance by the scale factor $40\,\text{km/cm}$ gives $2.5\times40 = 100\,$km; other options misuse addition or the scale factor.
